examples.title: DC voltage drop on a copper trace
examples.summary: A 10 mm synthetic copper trace, 5 V source and 1 A load, with an independent resistance check.
examples.dependencies: Python 3.11+ source checkout with development dependencies and a matching built SPIKE native module
steps: Save the canonical trace and import it through the canonical source importer.
Review VCC, source (0,0,F.Cu) and load (10,0,F.Cu), then explicitly run DC.
Compare the load drop with 4.926108 mV and inspect conservation and model status.
examples.limits: Supply-path approximation only; no return conductor, contact model or manufactured-board validation.

examples.title: AC R/L impedance sweep
examples.summary: Use the same original trace for a bounded five-point driving-point impedance sweep.
examples.dependencies: Python 3.11+ source checkout with development dependencies and a matching built SPIKE native module
steps: Import the canonical trace and review explicit source and load endpoints.
Set 1 MHz to 1 GHz, five points and capacitance model none.
Inspect complex R/L impedance, rejected modes and blocked uses.
examples.limits: No qualified C or G, characteristic impedance, propagation delay or transmission-line S-parameters.
examples.command: python -m python.spike_core.cli --output build/example-result.json analyze-ac examples/tutorial_pi_si/straight_trace.design.json --net VCC --source 0,0,F.Cu,source --load 10,0,F.Cu,load --start-hz 1000000 --stop-hz 1000000000 --points 5 --mesh-size-mm 2 --capacitance-model none

examples.title: Copper load-step transient
examples.summary: Apply a finite-rise current step and inspect the returned load-voltage frames.
examples.dependencies: Python 3.11+ source checkout with development dependencies and a matching built SPIKE native module
steps: Review the trace, 5 V source and 1 A final load.
Run the declared 8 us observation window and inspect solver timestep advice.
Refine timestep before interpreting transient peak; compare final voltage with 4.995074 V.
examples.limits: The historical 0.2 us step exceeds the solver recommendation; execution is not timestep convergence.
examples.command: python -m python.spike_core.cli --output build/example-result.json analyze-transient examples/tutorial_pi_si/straight_trace.design.json --net VCC --source 0,0,F.Cu,5 --load 10,0,F.Cu,1 --source-waveform constant --load-waveform step,0,2e-6,1e-6 --stop-time-s 8e-6 --time-step-s 2e-7 --capacitance-model none --mesh-size-mm 2
